sections.Profile:
Dungeon Door Defender, released by Mocean in September 2023, is a unique fusion of pinball and tower defense genres, designed exclusively for the Multimorphic P3 platform. Developed by Michael Ocean, the game utilizes the Heist and/or The Princess Bride playfield modules, challenging players to defend a castle door against successive waves of attackers.
